_about: Finance-sector threat profile (ADR 001 point 4, ADR 008, amended 2026-11-25). A curated judgment, not a source fact: neither ATT&CK nor KEV has a sector field. Every included group carries web evidence: a fetched public report (vendor research, government advisory or indictment, or a news report of one) that names a financial-sector victim or target, with URL, publication and fetch dates. Groups first chosen from ATT&CK text also keep that sentence, which a test checks against the pinned bundle. Status: approved by the owner on 2026-11-25 (see approval).
curation_rule: Include a group when a fetched public report names financial-sector organisations (banks, financial institutions, financial-services, investment or cryptocurrency-exchange companies, ATMs or SWIFT) among its victims or targets. An ATT&CK sentence alone is not enough (amended 2026-11-25, owner's request). 'primary': finance is the group's main target. 'listed': finance is one of several sectors. Being financially motivated, stealing payment cards at merchants, targeting finance policy bodies, or robbing other businesses' bank accounts is not enough. web_evidence.status: confirmed (a report names a finance victim or target), weak (finance appears only as a label, e.g. a figure), not_found (no fetched report names finance), not_finance (reports name victims outside finance).

groups.name: APT38
groups.source_sentence: Active since at least 2014, APT38 has targeted banks, financial institutions, casinos, cryptocurrency exchanges, SWIFT system endpoints, and ATMs in at least 38 countries worldwide.

sources.quote: In just the publicly reported heists alone, APT38 has attempted to steal over $1.1 billion dollars from financial institutions.

groups.name: Carbanak
groups.source_sentence: Carbanak is a cybercriminal group that has used Carbanak malware to target financial institutions since at least 2013.

sources.quote: Victims are mainly institutions in the financial industry

groups.name: Cobalt Group
groups.source_sentence: Cobalt Group is a financially motivated threat group that has primarily targeted financial institutions since at least 2016.

sources.quote: Banks of at least 14 countries including Russia, the UK, the Netherlands and Malaysia

groups.name: DarkVishnya
groups.source_sentence: DarkVishnya is a financially motivated threat actor targeting financial institutions in Eastern Europe.

sources.quote: At least eight banks in Eastern Europe were the targets of the attacks.

groups.name: GCMAN
groups.source_sentence: GCMAN is a threat group that focuses on targeting banks for the purpose of transferring money to e-currency services.

sources.quote: Kaspersky Lab's research team responded to three financial institutions in Russia that were infected with the GCMAN malware.

groups.name: Silence
groups.source_sentence: Silence is a financially motivated threat actor targeting financial institutions in different countries.

sources.quote: at least 16 new campaigns targeting banks launched by Silence.

groups.name: APT-C-36
groups.source_sentence: APT-C-36 has targeted government institutions and entities in the financial, energy, and professional manufacturing sectors across Colombia and other Latin American countries.

sources.quote: targeting entities in multiple sectors, including governmental institutions, financial companies

groups.name: APT19
groups.source_sentence: APT19 is a Chinese-based threat group that has targeted a variety of industries, including defense, finance, energy, pharmaceutical, telecommunications, high tech, education, manufacturing, and legal services.

sources.quote: In May and June 2017, FireEye observed a phishing campaign targeting at least seven global law and investment firms.

groups.name: APT41

sources.quote: Virtual currencies: including in-game currencies, cryptocurrencies, and related services.
sources.note: 'Financial' / 'Finance' appear only as labels in figures 1 and 2; the text names no bank or financial-services victim, and the 2020 DOJ indictment's victim list has none

groups.name: Andariel
groups.source_sentence: Andariel has primarily focused its operations--which have included destructive attacks--against South Korean government agencies, military organizations, and a variety of domestic companies; they have also conducted cyber financial operations against ATMs, banks, and cryptocurrency exchanges.

sources.quote: directly monetizing an operation in a previous case where ATMs were compromised in South Korea
sources.note: ATM compromise only; the same report's 2021 victims are manufacturing, home network, media and construction

groups.name: BlackTech

sources.quote: enterprises in the consumer electronics, computer, healthcare, and financial industries
sources.note: Shrouded Crossbow campaign, which Trend Micro links to BlackTech; the 2023 NSA/FBI/CISA/NPA advisory names no financial sector

groups.name: Deep Panda
groups.source_sentence: Deep Panda is a suspected Chinese threat group known to target many industries, including government, defense, financial, and telecommunications.

sources.quote: The targeted organizations operate in the financial, academic, cosmetics, and travel industries.
sources.note: secondary report of Fortinet's analysis; Fortinet's own post not fetched

groups.name: FIN7

sources.quote: victims within the following sectors have been targeted within the United States and Europe:

groups.name: FIN8

groups.name: FIN13

sources.quote: Over five years of Mandiant intrusion data shows FIN13 operates exclusively against organizations based in Mexico and has specifically targeted large organizations in the financial, retail, and hospitality industries.

groups.name: GALLIUM

sources.quote: extended its targeting beyond telecommunication companies to also include financial institutions and government entities

groups.name: MuddyWater

sources.quote: A U.S. bank, airport, non-profit and the Israeli operations of a U.S. software company were among the targets.

groups.name: OilRig

sources.quote: primarily focused on financial institutions and technology organizations within Saudi Arabia

groups.name: RedCurl

sources.quote: RedCurl made two attempts to attack the undisclosed Russian bank.
Victims included companies in the fields of construction, finance, consulting, retail, insurance, and law
